note: Direction allowances for inspect.mjs (it reads .taste-skill/direction.json automatically). Every entry is a decision, not a suppression.

reasons.few-pictures: Agreed constraint: the site carries no photography. The index and the documents are text-first.
reasons.no-footage: Same constraint: no video is used, and none is added as decoration.
reasons.palette-cream: Brand colour is set by DESIGN.md: warm cream #f8f5ed is the system canvas, not a replaceable decorative tint.
reasons.emoji: The only flagged symbols (a star, a tick, a magnifier) sit inside the SVG architecture plates as legend marks. They are illustration content; the page UI itself carries no emoji.
